title: Chapter 366 - 366 Praise; Courtesy!

Chapter 366 - 366 Praise; Courtesy!

Chapter 366 - 366 Praise; Courtesy!

366 Praise; Courtesy!

“Mr. Lin, welcome!”

“So, this is Mr. Lin. He’s younger than I thought.”

“How young!”

…

A wave of welcoming and discussion rang out in the palace.

All the topics were about Lin Fan.

Lin Fan did not care too much about this.

He looked at the food and wine neatly placed on the table and turned to the staff of Flower Stem. “Everyone should be hungry.”

As he spoke, he took a drumstick first.

In fact…

Everyone from Flower Stem was indeed a little hungry.

With Lin Fan taking the initiative, they did not hesitate anymore. They picked up the steak, chicken, and other delicacies and started eating in big mouthfuls.

At this moment, a crisp sound rang out not far away.

Then, a beautiful figure slowly walked over.

“Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Behind Lin Fan, a magnetic voice sounded, and there came the refreshing fragrance of Flower Stem’s perfume.

When Lin Fan heard that, he turned around slowly.

He saw a lady with fair skin, a voluptuous figure, exquisite facial features, and a head of silver hair that was tied up high. She wore a small silver crown… She gave off the feeling of a fairy walking out of a fairy tale. She was filled with a noble and sacred aura.

Although it was his first time seeing her, Lin Fan felt a sense of familiarity from the other party.

“Hello,” he said after a while.

“I’m Riley’s sister, Talia. Thank you for saving poor little Riley,” Talia said sincerely.

Lin Fan thought to himself, ‘So, she’s Riley’s older sister. No wonder she’s so familiar. However, it’s rare that she’s so fluent in the language of Hua Nation!’

“Mr. Lin, may I ask if you used Hua Nation’s magic—no, I should say a legendary technique—to save Lil Riley?”

Obviously, she was extremely curious about this.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “It’s not a legendary technique but traditional Hua Nation medicine.”

“Hua Nation medicine? It’s really amazing!” Talia said.

Then, she asked some questions about traditional medicine.

Lin Fan, who had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience, could answer all of them easily.

As Talia listened to Lin Fan’s narration, it was as if she was listening to a fairy tale. She was extremely fascinated.

At this moment, soft music sounded in the spacious hall.

At the same time, all the bright lights disappeared.

In its place were swaying stage lights.

“Mr. Lin, may I have a dance with you?” Talia asked.

Then, she seemed to have thought of something and turned to Chu Yunyue. “This should be Ms. Chu, right? May I borrow Mr. Lin for a few minutes?”

“Of course, no problem.” Chu Yunyue smiled.

From the looks of it, Talia seemed to be obsessed with Lin Fan.

However… Chu Yunyue was not jealous. On the contrary, she was very happy.

It was because Lin Fan was the person she liked.

At the same time, she had never thought of possessing Lin Fan alone.

The fact that Lin Fan was able to attract more people, including the princess of Eagle Country… Chu Yunyue was naturally very happy.

This further proved that the person she liked was very outstanding.

“Mr. Lin, shall we dance together?” Talia asked again.

Lin Fan said, “But… I’ve never danced.”

“It’s okay. I’ll teach you.” Talia did not wait for Lin Fan to speak again. She held his hand and walked toward the center of the dance floor.

She swayed her body to the music. At the same time, she did not forget to guide Lin Fan along with her.

Soon, Talia realized that she did not even need to guide Lin Fan.

On the contrary, she was the one receiving a lot of help from Lin Fan. He helped her make her movements smoother and smoother. She performed a perfect dance that she had never done before.

This kind of situation had never happened before despite dancing with the best dancers for many years.

…

Chu Yunyue was watching Lin Fan and Talia from afar.

Looking at their agile figures and elegant movements…

It was as if they were a pair of elves dancing in a dense forest. It was mesmerizing.

Chu Yunyue was still not jealous. Her beautiful eyes shone even brighter.

Lin Fan’s knowledge of perfumes far exceeded that of ordinary people. His singing voice was like the sound of nature, and his medical skills were amazing.

She also realized that Lin Fan had superb dancing skills.

It was impressive enough for anyone to possess one of these abilities.

However, Lin Fan alone possessed all of them.

Chu Yunyue even had a feeling that this was not all of Lin Fan’s abilities!

With this thought in mind, Chu Yunyue’s heart began to beat wildly.

He… was the person she liked!

…

The music gradually stopped, and all the stage lights gathered on Lin Fan and Talia.

Immediately, the resplendent palace was filled with warm applause.

In the past, they applauded mostly out of courtesy.

This time… everyone was sincere.

That was because Lin Fan and Talia’s dance was simply too good.

Talia smiled and said, “Mr. Lin, you just said that you haven’t danced before… Lying will make one grow a big nose.”

Lin Fan wanted to check if his nose had grown. He rubbed his nose and smiled helplessly.

In fact, he was not lying. He really had not danced.

However, Lin Fan had obtained Expert-Level Dance Techniques before.

He did not even need to have danced before. His body could instinctively perform an excellent dance.

He could not explain it at all.

At this moment, a series of dull footsteps sounded in the distance.

Following that, Queen Ibai, who had a benevolent expression without losing the dignity of the royal family, and a group of nobles slowly walked over.

“Greetings, Your Majesty,” everyone in the hall said in unison.

“Welcome, everyone.” Queen Ibai nodded.

Then, she used her slightly turbid eyes to scan the hall.

Finally, her gaze landed on Lin Fan.

“Mr. Lin, welcome to Eagle Country’s palace.”

“Thank you, Queen,” Lin Fan said.

“I should be the one thanking you,” Queen Ibai said. “Thank you for saving my Lil Riley.”

Her words were extremely sincere.

Today, the doctor did a comprehensive check-up on Riley and found that she had completely recovered.

Riley was Queen Ibai’s favorite.

Now, she was finally safe and sound.

This was all thanks to Lin Fan.

Then, Queen Ibai picked up a wine glass and said, “Mr. Lin, let me toast you!”

At the same time, everyone in the palace raised their glasses and said in unison, “To Mr. Lin!”

The queen and all the nobles toasted together in the palace!

This courtesy was unparalleled!
